description: A badger the size of a short man, in canvas overalls with the knees gone, standing with its hands behind its back and surveying the room like it is deciding what to fix first.
emotes: {it} sniffs at the air twice and comes to a conclusion.
{it} crouches to look at the floor, and stays down there a while.
{it} wipes both hands down the front of the overalls, achieving nothing.
looks: The overalls are filthy in a competent way, at the knees and the forearms and nowhere else.
The claws are enormous, and clean, and clearly the reason it does not carry many tools.
It is planted on both feet in a manner that suggests it is quite hard to move.
name: a badger in overalls
says: That will want doing before winter.
Whoever put that in was in a hurry.
I can get at it from underneath. That is not the problem.
